name: Hebeth
description: Hebeth was a moonless planet that occupied the third orbit around the star Beheboth in the Beheboth system, which was located in the Sanbra sector, a part of the Trailing Sectors portion of the Outer Rim Territories. Hebeth's surface consisted of molten rock.
